mission_03: Great work with random variables! You simulated 10,000 dice rolls and computed the empirical PMF, expected value, and variance. The theoretical E[X] = 3.5 and Var(X) = 2.917 match the simulation closely. You verified the linear transformation rules: for Y = 2X + 1, E[Y] = 8 and Var(Y) = 11.667. The simulation confirms these results. Random variables and their properties (expectation, variance, transformations) are fundamental to probability theory and machine learning — every prediction from an ML model is an estimate of an expected value.
